nba_directive.reason_text: This client is already engaged and asking about a refinance — they don't need to be sold, they need a frictionless path forward. Speed and a direct next step convert here; re-pitching or piling on questions will cool the lead.
nba_directive.recommended_strategy_text:
- Reply immediately and directly to whatever they asked — do not open with a generic refinance pitch
  - Acknowledge their current situation: $226,185 remaining balance, $1,145/mo P&I at 3.25% conventional
  - Answer their specific question first, in one or two sentences

- Skip the re-sell — they're already bought in
  - Do not ask discovery questions they've already answered (rate, product, balance are known)
  - Do not recite refinance benefits they clearly already understand

- Move straight to the soft credit pull / application
  - Say something like: 'I have your current details — the fastest way to show you exactly what your new payment and rate would be is to run a soft pull. It won't affect your credit and takes two minutes. Want me to send the e-sign link now?'
  - Send the e-sign or application link in the same message or immediately after their confirmation — do not wait for a scheduled callback if they're ready now

- If they hesitate, offer one concrete next-step alternative
  - A 10-minute call to walk through the numbers live — keep the friction low, not a full consultation
